fusions.name: Thrown on the Links
fusions.desc: The blade flies out on its links at a target up to 6 tiles away and hauls you to it, dealing 13 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach. The target moves 25% slower for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Whip Along
fusions.desc: Whips the tethered blade into the first enemy it meets for 7 damage, then on to 2 more enemies within 3.5 tiles, each for 60% of the damage. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Haul In the Slack
fusions.desc: Pulls up to 5 enemies within 6 tiles onto you and holds their attention for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Bound, Then Reaped
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying one of your afflictions, you deal 12% more damage.
